title: Password policy hardening
summary: Local public account passwords must be at least 12 characters and are checked against known breaches. Login and password-reset attempts are throttled per IP and per account, and a branded password-changed email is sent after a successful change or reset.
changes: Require passwords of at least 12 characters and reject known-breached passwords on register, guest reset, and signed-in password change.
Tighten public login and password-reset rate limits so attempts are counted separately per IP address and per account.
Send the MyAPES Account password-changed security email after a successful local password change, guest reset, or admin local-password reset.
affected_areas: Local password reset and profile password change
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: password policy hardening after step-up confirmation (0.39.1).
validation: PHPUnit PasswordPolicyHardeningTest, PublicLocalForgotPasswordTest, ProfileLocalPasswordChangeTest, AdminLocalPublicPasswordResetTest, StepUpAuthTest, ReviewFeedbackFixesTest.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Have I Been Pwned checks require outbound network access in production; tests stub the verifier so suites stay offline.
Directory and Cloudron OIDC staff accounts still have no local password reset or change paths.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Password length and breach checks return to the previous defaults, rate limiters use the prior combined keys, and password-changed emails stop firing from local password updates. No database migrations are included in this release.
